main_text.p: tonij Sadeelis opera in vnum volumen redigerentur, repertæ sunt Animaduersiones ipsius manu scriptæ ad marginem librorum Arturi (qui sero tamen ad ipsum peruenerat) quibus illi libri strictim refelluntur. Decreuerat autem præstantissimus ille vir integrum de Ecclesia tractatum scribere, in quo omnes in hoc argumento Aduersariorum obiectiones collectas, & quasi in vnum fasciculum congestas, simul semelque refutaret: quod inutilis foret laboris, istorum Repetitas cauillationes quotidie nouis Responsionibus refellere. Sed quum tam præclarū opus non construxerit: noluimus tamen Lectorem Christianum carere illis tanti viri tam egregiis animaduersionibus siue notulis, quas alioquin, si dignos hoc labore istos Arturi libros iudicasset, vberiore sty-

page.notes: The text is set in roman type with long-s rendered as s; the words "vnum", "vnum", "fasciculum" and "volumen" are printed as shown. Some words in the first line (vnum, Sadeelis) and a few damaged letters at the right edge of the lower lines are uncertain. The final word "stylo" is cut off by the page edge and is transcribed as "sty-" with the catchword "lo" below it.
